# Floorline AI

> Floorline AI (Floorline AI LLC) is a web design and AI agency based in San Tan Valley, Arizona. It builds fast, flat-fee websites, AI search visibility (AEO) and custom AI training platforms for restaurants and local businesses across the Phoenix metro. Not a flooring company.

- Founder: Michael Smith
- Location: San Tan Valley, AZ 85143 (Phoenix metro)
- Serves: San Tan Valley, Queen Creek, Mesa, Gilbert, Chandler, Scottsdale, Phoenix, Florence, Casa Grande; Maricopa and Pinal counties, AZ; remote projects in the U.S.
- Phone: 480-388-1877
- Email: Floorlineai@gmail.com
- Website pricing: $800–$2,500 one-time flat fee, no required monthly contract
- AI search pricing: free AI Visibility Audit; AI Visibility Fix $397 one-time; AI Visibility Monitor $197/month

## Services

- [Web design in San Tan Valley, AZ](https://www.floorlineai.com/web-design-san-tan-valley/): Mobile-first local business websites with SEO and AI-search setup included.
- [Web design in Mesa, AZ](https://www.floorlineai.com/web-design-mesa-az/): Custom websites for Mesa businesses, built for local Google and AI search.
- [AI search optimization (AEO)](https://www.floorlineai.com/ai-search-optimization/): Getting businesses found and cited by ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini.
- [Custom AI restaurant training platforms](https://www.floorlineai.com/restaurant-training-platforms/): Offline, no-login staff trainer apps, manager portals and allergen guides.
- [Free AI Visibility Audit](https://www.floorlineai.com/audit): Scans a website for AI crawler access, structured data and answer-ready content.
